change: Rank, dense_rank, percent_rank and cume_dist consume the existing WindowPeers cursor over immutable precomputed keys. They no longer rebuild partition/order expressions; cume_dist no longer rescans every suffix of a tied peer group.
contract: Sequential ranking has linear peer-boundary work and constant peer-cursor state. It retains existing output arrays. Peer indices remain governed by the existing measured-work threshold and budget admission; these single-pass tests allocate no index, including with a zero-byte peer budget.
correctnessFix: Real wide-timestamp HTTP ranking exposed windowReadColumns pruning unrelated source columns for an implicit all-column projection. Undefined, empty and wildcard select now retain all source columns. Explicit selections still prune to projected and operator-dependent columns.
admissionFoundation: MemoryReservationSource exposes only synchronous reserve/release needs. Decimal comparison and prepared comparison accept either an existing scope or a query budget, avoiding an owning scope per comparison. Operator ordering integration is still pending; no new decimal operator capability is advertised.

benchmarks.method: Presorted cume_dist kernel; row construction and independent output validation excluded; two warmups and three timed rounds. Local timings, not cloud throughput.

edgeCases: Empty and singleton inputs; all unique keys; seven-row peer groups; all tied input; 64 and 4096 rows.
Independent rank, dense-rank, percent-rank and cumulative-distribution formulas; at most four key reads per row; source expression getters throw if reevaluated.
Descending keys, null peers, multiple partitions and compatible sort prefixes; row execution matches partition merging across uneven and empty runs.
Repeated direct-budget decimal comparisons retain a concurrent sibling reservation, obey exact and one-byte-short limits, and return charges to baseline after success/failure.
Prepared decimal comparisons retain digit storage through callbacks and release after callback exceptions and admission failures.
realFixture: External parquet-testing flba12_timestamp.parquet, including signed wide epochs, over actual local HTTP 206 and ignored-range 200 responses. Four concurrent queries verify all four ranking functions plus all-tied cume_dist, preserve unrelated timestamp columns and keep read concurrency at two. Cache eviction leaves zero tracked bytes.
worker: Four concurrent native R2 ranking queries over generated Parquet with 1024-byte text rows, 64/128 MiB shared pools and reusable cache. Verifies unchanged full-row payload, rank and tied cume_dist.
limits: Peer-index admission is not output-array admission or total JavaScript heap. Existing row/window materialization allocation coverage remains incomplete. This is not a production Cloudflare memory certification. Exact decimal ordering, general decimal operators and final coverage/reproducibility remain open.
